title: WMP Test Vector
description: A single input/expected-output pair for WMP conformance testing.

kind.description: How the vector is executed. Absent means the kind of the file it is in, as listed in manifest.json.

setup.description: Server configuration for a transport-http vector (see README.md).

event_buffer.description: Per-session event buffer size, in events.

principals.description: Principal name to the Authorization header value that authenticates it.

input.description: The JSON-RPC message to send. For a transport-http vector: an array of steps (see README.md).

expected_response.description: The expected JSON-RPC response (if request). Use null to assert no response is produced (e.g. notifications).

handler_action.description: Instruction for the test harness handler. Used only in interop tests.

return.description: Value to return from the handler.

error.description: JSON-RPC error object to return from the handler.

peer_options.description: Peer-level configuration for the test harness. Used only in interop tests.

authorize.description: If false, the authorizer hook rejects the request.

validate.description: If false, the validator hook rejects the params.

must_refuse.description: Negative vector: the input is a message a conforming receiver MUST refuse (a flow.complete a client rejects, or a sign result the server fails the flow for). The harness asserts that its conformance check reports a violation; every vector without this member must pass the check.
